requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder class inherits from Builder but doesn't correctly implement the async generator handling. Tests fail because the async_generator object has no 'send' attribute, indicating the generator execution is not properly handled for async contexts.
requirement.contract: The AsyncOptionBuilder.__call__ method should properly handle async generators by converting them to a format compatible with the base Builder._send method. The implementation should correctly manage async generator execution and handle the send() method calls appropriately.

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder class inherits from Builder but doesn't implement the zero() method. This causes NotImplementedError when tests try to call it.
requirement.contract: The AsyncResultBuilder class must implement the zero() method to return an appropriate empty result value. The method should return an Error result with a default error type.

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder class doesn't properly handle list_iterator objects which don't have a 'send' attribute. This leads to AttributeError when trying to execute the builder with list iterators.
requirement.contract: The SeqBuilder class should properly handle different iterable types including list_iterator objects by implementing appropriate conversion or handling mechanisms.

requirement.description: The base Builder._send method assumes generators have a 'send' attribute but doesn't properly handle async generators. This causes AttributeError when dealing with async_generator objects in async contexts.
requirement.contract: The Builder._send method should handle both regular generators and async generators differently, properly checking for async generator types and using appropriate execution methods.
requirement.acceptance: All async-related tests in test_async_option_builder.py and test_async_result_builder.py

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder.__call__ method needs to be adapted to handle async generator scenarios properly, similar to how AsyncOptionBuilder is expected to work.
requirement.contract: The AsyncResultBuilder.__call__ method should properly handle async generators and convert them to a format compatible with the base Builder implementation.
requirement.acceptance: All async_result builder tests that are currently failing
